meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 它会引导你为某个渠道接通第一个 NanoClaw agent：确认你在该渠道的用户身份，创建或复用 agent 与 DM 消息组，并让 agent 沿正常投递路径发出一条欢迎私信。脚本是幂等的，重复运行安全。
howto.when: 当你已经配好渠道凭据、服务正在运行，并要求为某个渠道接通第一个 agent 时接管。服务未运行时原文提示先执行 /setup。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 上接通第一个 agent，并给我发一条欢迎私信
say.note: 脚本创建 agent 与 DM 组并排队欢迎私信

say.text: 欢迎私信没收到，去查一下 outbound.db 里消息的状态
say.note: 按原文诊断步骤检查 pending 或投递失败

howto.what_en: It walks you through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel: resolve your channel identity, create or reuse the agent and DM messaging group, and send a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Rerunning is safe.
howto.when_en: Use it after channel credentials are configured and the service is running; it takes over when you ask to set up the first agent for a channel.

say_en.text: Wire up the first agent on Discord for me and send me a welcome DM
say_en.note: Creates the agent and DM group, queues the welcome DM

say_en.text: My Telegram user id is 12345 - create the DM agent under my display name
say_en.note: Resolves that user id and wires the DM messaging group

say_en.text: I didn't get the welcome DM - check outbound.db for its status
say_en.note: Runs the original diagnosis steps for stuck or failed sends
